nodes.summary: For a quiescent state $m$ of the 3-COLOR emitter and a copy site $j$, the bit list of $j$ at $m$ is $v$ ones followed by the constant block of $j$, where $v$ is the value in $m$ of the counter that $j$ copies. Read top-first, the ones lie above the constant block.
nodes.title: Bit list of a copy site of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: For a quiescent state $m$ of the 3-COLOR emitter and copy sites $j_1, \dots, j_k$, the bits of the sequence at $m$ are the bit lists at $m$ of $j_k, j_{k-1}, \dots, j_1$, concatenated in that order. Read top-first, the bits of the last site lie on top.
nodes.title: Bits pushed by a sequence of copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: Let copy sites $j_1, \dots, j_k$ run in sequence from label $\ell_0$ to label $\ell$, and let $m$ be a quiescent state of the 3-COLOR emitter whose counters $N$, $R$, $U$ have values $n$, $r$, $u$. Then for every Boolean $v$ there is a Boolean $v'$ such that the emitter goes in at most $k (2 (n + r + u) + 3)$ steps from label $\ell_0$ with internal state $v$ and the stacks of $m$ to label $\ell$ with internal state…
nodes.title: Running a sequence of copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: Copy sites $j_1, \dots, j_k$ run in sequence from label $\ell_0$ to label $\ell$ when $\ell_0$ is the entry label of $j_1$, the continuation label of each $j_i$ with $i < k$ is the entry label of $j_{i+1}$, and the continuation label of $j_k$ is $\ell$; for $k = 0$ this means $\ell_0 = \ell$. The condition is a Boolean test.
nodes.title: Copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter running in sequence

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a quiescent state of the 3-COLOR emitter whose OR-output counter $R$ has value $r$, let $v$ be a Boolean and $b$ a Boolean. Then there is a Boolean $v'$ such that the emitter runs in exactly $r + 1$ steps from label $\mathsf{clr}(b)$ with internal state $v$ and the stacks of $m$ to the stacks of $m$ with $R$ set to $0$ and internal state $v'$, at label $\mathsf{fA}(\mathrm{false})$ if $b$ is true and at…
nodes.title: The 3-COLOR emitter clears its OR-output counter

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a quiescent state, $u$ and $w$ lists of bits, and $R$ a list of symbols that is empty or does not start with a name bit. If stack $A$ of $m$ holds $u$ as name bits and stack $D$ holds $w$ as name bits followed by $R$, then from label $\mathsf{cmp}$ with the stacks of $m$ and any flag, the emitter reaches, in at most $3|w| + 3$ steps, label $\mathsf{sel}$ if $u = w$ and label $\mathsf{mvN}(\mathrm{none})$…
nodes.title: Name comparison in the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: An occurrence $q = (x, p, L, M)$ of the literal $(x, p)$ with vertices $L$ and $M$ is written, top first, as the polarity marker of $p$, then the name bits of the variable $x$, then $L$ unit symbols (its literal vertex in unary); the vertex $M$ is not recorded.
nodes.title: Encoding of an earlier occurrence on stack $D$

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a quiescent state and $u$ the value of its counter $U$. From label $\mathsf{dr}$ with the stacks of $m$ and any flag, the emitter reaches label $\mathsf{walk}$ in exactly $u + 1$ steps, with some flag and the stacks of $m$ except that $U$ is empty (value $0$) and $u$ unit symbols are pushed onto $E$.
nodes.title: Moving $U$ onto $E$

nodes.title: Copying a counter through $W$

nodes.summary: For every quiescent state $m$ with counters $n$ on stack $N$ and $r$ on stack $R$, every local state $v$ and every boolean $b$, the emitter goes from label $\mathrm{fA}(b)$ with state $(v, m)$ to label $\mathrm{fC}(b)$, with some local state, in exactly $2n + 2$ steps, ending in the state $m$ with the counter on $R$ replaced by $n + r$; the counter $N$ is restored through the scratch stack $W$.
nodes.title: Adding the vertex counter to the OR output

nodes.summary: A symbol is a walk token, one the walk moves between the stacks $D$ and $E$, when it is a name bit, a literal marker or the clause symbol (which also serves as the unary unit); the value symbols and the dead symbol are not walk tokens.
nodes.title: Walk tokens

nodes.summary: For each of the three counters read by copy sites of the 3-coloring emitter, the stack of the counter is not the output stack $O$.
nodes.title: Counters are not held on the output stack

nodes.summary: The name of a variable $x \in \mathbb{N}$ is the list of name-bit tokens $\mathtt{bit}(b)$, one for each bit $b$ of Mathlib's binary encoding of $x$ (least significant bit first, empty for $x = 0$), in that order; this is how the stacks $A$ and $D$ hold it.
nodes.title: Name of a variable

If the token stack $T$ of $m$ is the name of $x$ in reverse order followed by $R$, then for some bit $v'$ the emitter machine runs in exactly $k + 1$ steps, where $k$ is the length of the binary encoding of $x$, from label…
nodes.title: Moving the current name from $T$ to $A$

nodes.summary: Let $j$ be a copy site, $m$ a quiescent state and $v$ a local state, and let $c$ be the value in $m$ of the counter that $j$ copies. From the label that starts site $j$, with local state $v$, the machine runs in exactly $2c + 3$ steps to the label where $j$ continues, in some local state and in the quiescent state obtained from $m$ by pushing onto the output stack $c$ ones above the constant block of $j$.
nodes.title: Running a copy site of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a quiescent state of the 3-COLOR emitter whose occurrence stack consists of $j$ units above a stack $R$ that is empty or does not have a unit on top. From the label $\mathsf{skU}$, with any local state, the machine runs in exactly $j + 1$ steps to the label $\mathsf{walk}$, in some local state and in the quiescent state obtained from $m$ by replacing the occurrence stack with $R$ and pushing $j$ units…
nodes.title: Skipping an earlier literal vertex

nodes.summary: The stack contents of a quiescent state $m$ of the 3-coloring emitter: the token, output, earlier-occurrence, walk, name and polarity stacks hold the corresponding lists of $m$; the counters $N$, $R$, $F$ and $U$ hold $n$, $r$, $f$ and $u$ copies of the clause-end symbol, where $n$, $r$, $f$, $u$ are the counter values of $m$; and the scratch stacks $X$, $B$ and $W$ are empty.
nodes.title: Stacks of a quiescent state

nodes.summary: For a quiescent state $m$ of the 3-coloring emitter, the value of the next-vertex counter is the next free vertex $n$ of $m$, that of the OR-output counter is the current OR output $r$ of $m$, and that of the earlier-literal counter is the earlier literal vertex $u$ of $m$.

Theory of Computation

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
